source:
• 你召唤以野兽形态存在的精魂，并使其显现在施法范围内一处你能看见但未被占据的空间。选择以下选项之一作为显现的生物：
→一只挑战等级2或者更低的野兽
→两只挑战等级1或者更低的野兽
→四只挑战等级1/2或更低的野兽
→八只挑战等级1/4或更低的野兽
• 每只野兽同时视为精类生物，并且在生命值降至0时，或者法术终止时消失不见。
• 被召唤的生物对你和你的伙伴保持友善关系。每次召唤出来的所有生物视为一个团体来掷先攻权，并依此获得其自己的行动回合。他们服从你发出的所有语言命令（不需要你作动作）。如果你不发出任何命令，这些生物会在敌对生物前保护自己，如果没有敌对生物则不执行任何动作。
• 这些生物的具体数值由DM掌控。
• 升环施法效应：使用更高法术位施展该法术时，选择上文所述召唤选项之一，并显现更多生物：5环法术位显现两倍生物，7环法术位显现三倍生物，9环法术位显现四倍生物。
target:
• You summon spirits that take the forms of beasts and appear in an unoccupied space you can see within range. Choose one of the following options for the creatures that appear:
→ One beast of challenge rating 2 or lower
→ Two beasts of challenge rating 1 or lower
→ Four beasts of challenge rating 1/2 or lower
→ Eight beasts of challenge rating 1/4 or lower
• Each beast is also considered a fey and disappears when its hit points drop to 0 or when the spell ends.
• The summoned creatures are friendly to you and your companions. All the creatures from each casting roll initiative as a group and take their own turns accordingly. They obey all your verbal commands, which require no action from you. If you give no commands, they defend themselves against hostile creatures; if there are no hostile creatures, they take no actions.
• The DM has the creatures' statistics.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a higher-level spell slot, choose one of the summoning options above and summon more creatures: twice as many with a 5th-level slot, three times as many with a 7th-level slot, or four times as many with a 9th-level slot.

source: • 你向空中射出一发非魔法的弹药或者掷出一把非魔法的投掷武器，并以之为原型向前方锥状区域内射出一片同样的武器，而这些创造出的武器将在攻击完成后消失不见。前方60 尺锥状区域内的每个生物都必须进行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失败者将受到3d8点伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。法术所造成伤害的类型与用作法术成分材料的弹药或武器相同。
target: • You fire a piece of nonmagical ammunition into the air or throw a nonmagical thrown weapon, using it as the model for a barrage of identical weapons that shoots into a cone ahead of you. The created weapons disappear after the attack is complete. Each creature in the 60-foot cone ahead of you must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d8 damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The damage type is the same as that of the ammunition or weapon used as the spell's material component.

• 你试图打断一个生物正在施展的一个法术。如果该生物正在施展3环或更低环阶法术，则其法术失败且不产生任何效应。如果该生物正在施展4环或更高环阶法术，则你以施法关键属性进行一次属性检定，其检定DC等于10＋目标法术的环阶。检定成功则目标法术失败且不产生任何效应。

target:
• You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell. If the creature is casting a spell of 3rd level or lower, its spell fails and has no effect. If it is casting a spell of 4th level or higher, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the target spell's level. On a successful check, the target spell fails and has no effect.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the target spell is automatically interrupted if its level is no higher than the level of the spell slot you use.

• 你接触一个可见生物的思想并迫使它进行一次智力豁免检定。免疫恐慌的生物自动通过此豁免。若豁免失败，目标失去从敌人中辨别友伴的能力，将所有可见的生物识别为敌人直到法术结束。每次目标受到伤害时它都可以重复进行此豁免，若成功将结束它对自己的效果。
• 每当受影响的生物选择另一个生物作为目标时，它必在攻击、法术或其他可用能力的范围里，从所有可见目标中随机选择目标。如果一名敌人提供了借机攻击的机会给受术生物，生物必须进行攻击，只要它有能力这么做。

target:

• 选择距离内你能看见的，位于地面上的一点。以该点为中心，20尺立方的空间内，一道翻滚的泥土和岩石流喷发而出。在该区域中的每个生物必须进行一次敏捷豁免检定。若未通过豁免，该生物受到3d12点钝击伤害，成功的豁免令上述伤害减半。此外，该区域的地面成为困难地形直到被清理。该区域每5平方尺的空间，若用手来清理至少需要1分钟时间。

target:

• 你触碰一自愿生物并将其变得如死去一样的僵直状态。
你可以用一个动作再次触碰该目标以终止该法术。在法术持续时间内，对目标进行的任何肉体检查和法术检测都显示目标已处于死亡状态。该状态下的目标陷入目盲以及失能状态，且其移动速度降低为0。目标对除了心灵伤害外的所有伤害类型具有抗性。如果目标在受术时正陷入疾病或中毒状态，或者在法术生效时陷入疾病或中毒状态，则这些状态在该法术持续时间内受抑制而无效，直至法术终止时再回复生效。
target:
• You touch a willing creature and put it into a rigid state resembling death.
You can use an action to touch the target again and end this spell. For the spell's duration, all physical examinations and magical detection show the target to be dead. In this state, the target is blinded and incapacitated, and its speed is reduced to 0. It has resistance to every damage type except psychic. If the target is diseased or poisoned when the spell is cast, or becomes diseased or poisoned while it is in effect, those conditions are suppressed and have no effect for the spell's duration. They resume when the spell ends.

• 在法术持续时间内，你将触碰到的一个自愿生物连同其穿着携带物一起转化为一团云雾。如果生物的生命值降至0则法术终止。非实体的生物不受该效应影响。
• 在该形态下，目标唯一的移动方式即是10尺的飞行速度。该目标可以进入并占据一个已有生物占据的空间。其拥有非魔法伤害的抗性，且进行力量、敏捷和体质豁免时具有优势。该目标可以穿过小洞、狭隙、甚至裂缝，但他会将液态物质视为固体表面。目标即使处于震慑或者失能状态时，也不会坠落并且保持在空中悬浮。
• 云雾形态的目标不能讲话或操作物件，其随身携带或持握的物件不会掉落，也不能被使用或与之互动。另外，目标也不能攻击或施法。
target:
• For the spell's duration, you transform a willing creature you touch, together with everything it is wearing and carrying, into a cloud of mist. The spell ends if the creature's hit points drop to 0. Incorporeal creatures are unaffected.
• In this form, the target's only means of movement is a flying speed of 10 feet. It can enter and occupy another creature's space. It has resistance to nonmagical damage and advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws. It can pass through small holes, narrow openings, and even cracks, but treats liquids as solid surfaces. Even while stunned or incapacitated, the target does not fall and remains hovering in the air.

• 施展该法术时，你在某个表面（诸如桌面、地板、墙等）或某个能被关闭以隐藏符纹的物件里（诸如书本、卷轴、宝箱等）刻画一个伤害其他生物的符纹。如果你指定某个表面，则此符纹可以覆盖周边不超过10尺直径的区域。如果你指定某个物件，则该物件必须待在其所在位置；如果该物件从被施法位置被移开超过10尺，则其符纹被破坏且法术不被触发即刻终止。
• 结界符纹近乎隐形，其需要以法术的豁免DC 进行一次智力（调查）检定才能被发现。
• 你在施法时设定结界符纹的触发条件。刻画于表面的符纹其最典型的触发条件包括：触碰或站立在符纹上；拿掉覆盖在符纹上的物件；进入符纹一定施法距离；操作符纹所在的物件等。刻画在物件内的符纹其最典型的触发条件包括：打开物件；靠近物件一定的距离；看到或阅读该符纹等。符纹一旦被触发，则该法术终止。
• 你可以进一步细化触发条件，比如设定法术触发时符合特定的条件，或设定其触发者必须具备特定身体特征（身高体重等），特定生物种类（例如设定为只影响异怪或卓尔）或特定阵营。你还可以将特定条件者排除在符纹触发者之外，诸如某说出特定口令的人。
• 刻画符纹时，你可以从爆炸符文和法术符纹两者中选择其一。
• 爆炸符文 Explosive Runes：符文被触发时将在半径20尺球状区域内将爆发魔法能量，并绕过角落扩散。区域内的每个生物必须进行一次敏捷豁免。豁免失败者将受到5d8的强酸，冷冻，火焰，闪电，或雷鸣伤害（你在制造符纹时指定），豁免成功则伤害减半。

• 你在施法距离内一处40尺立方区域内指定至多六个生物并扭曲其周围的时间流。每个目标都要进行一次感知豁免，豁免失败则受到该法术影响直至法术终止。

target:
• Choose up to six creatures in a 40-foot cube within range and distort the flow of time around them. Each target must make a Wisdom saving throw, becoming affected by the spell until it ends on a failed save.
• An affected creature's speed is halved, it takes a -2 penalty to AC and Dexterity saving throws, and it cannot take reactions. On its turn, it can take an action or a bonus action, but not both. Regardless of its abilities or magic items, it can make only one melee or ranged attack on its turn.
• If the creature attempts to cast a spell with a casting time of 1 action, roll a d20. On a result of 11 or higher, its spell does not take effect until its next turn, when it must use another action to complete the spell. If it cannot do so, the spell is wasted.
• At the end of its turn, an affected creature can make another Wisdom saving throw, ending the spell's effect on itself on a success.

• 你给施法距离内一具尸体赋予少许生命与智力，让其可回答你的问题。这具尸体必须还有一张嘴，且不能是不死生物。若目标尸体在最近十日内曾被作为该法术的目标，则本次施法失败。

target:
• You grant a corpse within range a semblance of life and intelligence, allowing it to answer your questions. The corpse must still have a mouth and cannot be undead. The casting fails if the corpse has been a target of this spell within the last ten days.
• Before the spell ends, you can ask the corpse up to five questions. Its knowledge is limited to what it knew in life, including the languages it spoke. Its answers are usually brief, vague, or repetitive. If you are hostile toward the corpse, or it regards you as an enemy, it is not obliged to answer truthfully. This spell does not return the creature's soul to its body; it only animates its spirit. Consequently, the corpse cannot learn new information, understand anything that happened after its death, or speculate about future events.

• 该法术能让纠缠术 Entangle创造出来的植物放开一个被束缚的生物。

小型精类

速度：40尺
力量13（+1）  敏捷16（+3）  体质14（+2）

• Until the spell ends, you control any freestanding body of water within a cube you designate that is 100 feet on a side. When you cast the spell, choose one of the effects below. On each of your subsequent turns, you can use an action to repeat the same effect or choose a different one.
• Flood. You raise the water level in the area by up to 20 feet. If the area includes a shore, the rising water spills over the dry land it covers.
  If the area you choose is part of a large body of water, you instead create a 20-foot-high wave that travels from one side of the area to the other before crashing down. Huge or smaller vehicles in the wave are carried to the opposite side in the wave's direction of travel. All Huge or smaller vehicles have a 25% chance of capsizing.
  The raised water level remains until the spell ends or you choose another effect. If you use this effect to create a wave, the wave repeats at the start of your next turn.
• Part Water. You part the water in the area to form a trench. The trench extends from one end of the spell's area to the other, with the parted water forming walls on both sides. The trench remains until the spell ends or you choose another effect. When this effect ends, the trench slowly fills over the course of the next round until the water returns to its normal level.
• Redirect Flow. You make the water in the area flow in a direction you choose. It can flow around obstacles, up walls, or in other unlikely directions. Water within the area follows your direction, but once it leaves the spell's area, it resumes flowing as the local terrain dictates. The water continues flowing in your chosen direction until the spell ends or you choose another effect.
• Whirlpool. This effect requires a body of water at least 50 feet square and at least 25 feet deep. You form a whirlpool in the center of the area. It is 5 feet wide at the bottom, 50 feet wide at the top, and 25 feet high. Any creature or object in the water within 25 feet of the whirlpool is pulled 10 feet toward it. An affected creature can make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC to swim free of the whirlpool.

• 你的魔法和贡品让你得以与一名神祇或神仆取得联络。你可以就某个特定的目标、事件或活动提问一个与其7日内状况相关的问题。DM 将给予你真实的答复，这个答复可能是一段短语、一节神秘的短诗或是一个预兆。
• 此法术的回答并不会顾及所有可能影响结果的情况。比如其他法术的影响，或者同伴的加入和离开等状况。
• 若你在两次长休之间两次或更多次的施展该法术，则法术有概率会给出随机的结果。此概率从第二次施展起每次累计25％。其具体结果由DM暗骰决定。
target:
• Your magic and offering put you in contact with a deity or a divine servant. You can ask one question about the circumstances of a particular goal, event, or activity within the next 7 days. The DM gives you a truthful answer, which might be a short phrase, a cryptic poem, or an omen.
• The answer does not account for every possible circumstance that might affect the outcome, such as the influence of other spells or the arrival or departure of companions.
• If you cast this spell two or more times between long rests, it has a chance of giving a random result. Starting with the second casting, this chance increases cumulatively by 25% for each casting. The DM rolls secretly to determine the result.
